subject.title: fix(gateway): bound SQLite title field reads for sessions.list

question: Should SQLite title derivation preserve the existing/file-backed head-search reach, or is a fixed ten-message cap an approved user-visible title semantics change?
rationale: The proposed cap materially changes when an existing session receives a derived title, and the repository policy treats changed fallback and persisted-session behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve title reach
options.body: Replace the fixed ten-message head with a bounded head reader whose byte reach matches the file-backed 8 KiB contract, then cover compact messages with a late eligible user.

options.title: Approve the narrower cap
options.body: Accept that some existing SQLite sessions will no longer derive a title after ten earlier records and document the intentional divergence.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Hold the PR if neither a compatible bounded-head primitive nor explicit acceptance of the semantic change is available.

recommendation.title: Preserve title reach
recommendation.body: Replace the fixed ten-message head with a bounded head reader whose byte reach matches the file-backed 8 KiB contract, then cover compact messages with a late eligible user.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be reliably attributed, but the gateway/session-history owner is needed for the compatibility choice.
